direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Refit inspector evidence list so the second card and scrollbar are fully visible at 768px; internal scroll with visible end fade.
Enlarge SVG job and evidence labels to 11px minimum; silverDim text is low contrast over grid.
Reduce opening-story height by 12px to give the 120 versus 80 mismatch tracks more breathing room without page scroll.
Keep ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate labelled regions with independent status lines; do not merge their controls.
Add a clear nonce and identity health line inside pre-flight only, distinct from the investigation run state.
Enlarge the three option chips under the jobs to 36px targets with focus ring.
Preserve selected-path opening the typed consent form; keep Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches and announce match state via aria-live.
The guide subtitle wraps to two lines and clips; shorten to one line or refit guide to fit 52px.
Align Finish and Incremental columns across the three option cards on one tabular baseline.
Proposal list clips t3 and the end-of-proposals note; make the list internally scrollable and show a count plus scroll hint within the viewport.
Label proposed tasks visibly UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on each card, not only in the header summary.
Remove duplicate primary emphasis: keep Approve in the action bar primary and demote the inspector duplicate to secondary.
Make PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE use pattern plus text on the SVG cell so preview is distinct from the actual stopped state before applying.
Scenario management admin row looks disabled but focusable state is unclear; give it 36px target, focus ring, or mark non-interactive text.
Strengthen the invalidating-action warning in the action bar with an icon and text, not colour alone.
Stopped CELL-MILL-2 in red with hatch and STOPPED text is correct; ensure no neon route touches it and legend states that exception.
Keep pre-flight route health separate from reinvestigation evidence task, with nonce and identity checks only under pre-flight.
Enlarge CONSTRAINED hatch label to 11px and keep its reason available on focus.
Keep prior acceptance invalidated banner persistent beside the revised typed consent form; do not let it scroll away in the inspector.
Constrained Split card shows dashes for Finish and Incremental; replace with explicit unavailable text at 11px minimum.
Shorten the revised-decision helper line so plan identifier and exact phrase stay on separate readable lines.
Blocked prior tasks overlap the proposed list and text is struck through at small size; separate the two groups with clear headings and enlarge blocked task text.
State Approved revised plan, replacement tasks await approval in the inspector header so blocked and proposed states coexist unambiguously.
Refit the right list so t1 is fully visible without relying on a cut-off scroll cue.
Number the three retention stages with locked and unlocked states in text; stage 2 and 3 reasons must remain readable at 768px.
Passphrase checklist wraps densely; set at 12px with clear separate-passphrase warning and character count.
Label the 70, 35h and 48h before-after metrics so the proof summary is understood without narration.
Add a single completion status sentence in the action bar already present; keep it as the only summary and avoid adding a second primary action.
Ensure Recovery story complete in the rail has aria-current and a check plus text, not colour alone.
Keep Export independent checkpoint as secondary after sealing, with focus ring and completed states retained for all three stages.
